flags.reason: misreads-source: The cited fact says only "`buttonSlot={null}` removes it". The item adds "or false", which nothing cited supports. The 0.1.78 evidence also says "`buttonSlot={null}` still renders the default \"Button\"", so the removal claim rests on the newer types alone.

lost-context: "The close button is always labelled “Close”" describes the default close IconButton. Facts /facts/props/8 and /facts/gaps/3 say closeSlot replaces that default. Targeting closeSlot applies the "always" to a custom close, which the source does not cover.

notes: The package-type facts disagree with the guide and the 0.1.78 evidence. /facts/props/7 says showClose defaults to true, while the guide and evidence say the package "adds it only when asked" (default false). /facts/props/1 says title defaults to "", while the guide says "Without props it reads “Split payment” and “Button”". The 13 October evidence explains this: c1fa197 carries the #206 changes and the guide copy "wasn't re-checked". Items that rest on the old behaviour may be stale once #206 is published: /configuration/6 (add a close when people may dismiss it), /content/rules/4 (placeholder copy, so set all three) and /doDont/1. /configuration/15 marks Dark as discouraged. The guide only says the page shows Light only, but the evidence (title about 1.1:1, effectively invisible) makes avoiding Dark reasonable.
